summary.text: Everett Jackson is the Republican nominee for the open Texas 30th District seat. FOX 4 describes him as a small business owner and community organizer. He advanced from the March 2026 Republican primary and won the May 26, 2026 runoff over Sholdon Daniels.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Jackson as also known as "Pharaoh."
The March 3, 2026 Republican primary also included Sholdon Daniels, Gregor Heise and Nils Walker, and Jackson advanced to a runoff, in which he defeated Daniels on May 26, 2026.
